query:
SELECT 
  ms.name,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND mc.imageUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_images
FROM marvel_cards mc
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id
WHERE ms.name LIKE '%Chrome%' AND ms.name NOT LIKE '%Sapphire%' AND ms.name NOT LIKE '%Studios%'
   OR ms.name LIKE '%Comic Book%'
GROUP BY ms.name;
